Два способа анализа. «Файл»: перетащите:
Two analysis sources are available. File: drop one audio file or region onto the waveform, or click Open File. The entire file is analyzed in the background without playback; the result is saved in the project. Live: start project playback to analyze the track input. A musical passage of 12–20 seconds is usually needed. Ambiguous material may show “Insufficient data”; detection is not guaranteed to be exact.

The imported file is used only for analysis. Pitch Shift always processes the project track audio. A dropped region is analyzed from the file supplied by the DAW; this may differ from the track after editing or other effects.

The knob shifts the track’s pitch, including project export. A quarter-tone step equals 50 cents or 0.5 semitones. Tempo and duration are preserved. Range: one octave down to one octave up.

Before / After compares the original and processed audio. Bypass disables processing. No system player, microphone or recording is required.

The ½ and ×2 buttons adjust the detected BPM; they do not change playback speed. Analyze Again resets detection. A/B stores two sets of processing settings. Keys use English note names. A quarter-tone shift adds a cents offset to the key name.
